info.name: HRMS — Terms & Policies Module
info.description: Country-scoped Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy. Super Admin publishes a new version by uploading a .docx; the backend extracts the content, files it as the next version, retires the previous one, and notifies every company admin in that country by in-app notification and email. Companies accept at registration and can re-accept from their profile. Set collection variables: base_url, token, super_admin_token, company_id, policy_document_id.

query.description: ISO alpha-2 OR a country name — 'uae' and 'United Arab Emirates' both work. Falls back to the global policy when the country has none of its own.

request.description: Both consent flags are mandatory. They are validated BEFORE anything is written, so a refused registration leaves no company behind. The acceptance is filed against the versions live at that moment, along with the caller's IP and user agent (taken from the request, not the body).

400 Consent not given

request.description: Any authenticated user of the company. `pending_acceptance` is computed, not stored — it appears the moment Super Admin publishes a version marked requires_reacceptance.

request.description: Returns content_html for rendering plus source_file_url to download the original .docx. Serves the current version for the company's own country only.

Send back the id of the document that was displayed. If it has since been superseded the call is rejected with 409 rather than silently recording consent to text the admin never saw. Omit the field to accept whatever is current.

response.name: 409 Superseded

formdata.description: REQUIRED. Word .docx only — the legacy binary .doc is rejected with a Save-As hint. Max 15MB.
ISO alpha-2 or a country name. Leave BLANK for the global default, which serves every country without its own document.
Optional — defaults to the document's own opening heading.
Shown in the notification and the email.
false for a typo fix: admins are told, but no outstanding action is raised.

request.description: Parses the .docx into HTML BEFORE writing anything, so a malformed file leaves the previous version live and no orphan upload behind. Then, in one transaction: bump the version, retire the incumbent, insert the new document. Afterwards it audits the action and notifies every company admin in the affected country. Notification and email failures are logged, never rolled back.

response.name: 201 Created
400 Wrong file type
